name: clinic-automation
description: Client-management automation for a small clinic/service business: public booking + intake + status lookup, client DB + CSV import + admin dashboard, no-double-book scheduling, WhatsApp Cloud API automation, PDF receipts/consent, daily/weekly reporting.

scripts.check: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/config.js && echo OK
scripts.sanity: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['src/config.js','src/app.js','src/server.js','src/db/db.js','src/db/repository.js','src/middleware/auth.js','src/services/auth.js','src/services/csvImport.js','src/services/scheduling.js','src/services/intake.js','src/services/messaging.js','src/services/staffNotify.js','src/services/pdf.js','src/services/reports.js','src/services/digest.js','src/routes/clients.js','src/routes/admin.js','src/routes/import.js','src/routes/bookings.js','src/routes/intake.js','src/routes/status.js','src/routes/webhook.js','src/routes/receipts.js','src/routes/reports.js','src/whatsapp/provider.js','src/whatsapp/templates.js','src/jobs/index.js','src/jobs/reminders.js','src/jobs/followups.js','src/jobs/reengagement.js'];let bad=0;for(const f of files){if(!fs.existsSync(f)){console.error('MISSING '+f);bad=1;}}if(bad){process.exit(1);}console.log('sanity: all '+files.length+' expected source files present');"
